column1: # mdl-scan-rules.tsv — one row per STOP row of skills/learned-mdl-preflight.md that a text pattern
# identifies. Read by bin/mdl-scan.sh. Columns, TAB-separated:
#   id       STOP-<n>, the preflight row number
#   kind     line          ERE on the comment-stripped, lowercased line (strings kept)
#            customcontent ERE on the same line with string literals blanked, only inside a
#                          datagrid column body whose header says ShowContentAs: customContent
#            contentparams built-in: a ContentParams value that is not a bare attribute,
#                          an unquoted association path or a quoted literal (pattern unused)
#   severity warn   exec.sh prints the hit and goes on; the BUILD-LOG row notes it
#            block  exec.sh refuses (MXTK_SCAN_OVERRIDE="<reason>" is the user's override)
#            A rule ships as `warn`. It goes to `block` only after ONE field run in which it
#            caught a real failure and flagged nothing valid, cited on the commit that flips
#            it. Candidates: STOP-12, STOP-16, STOP-26. STOP-1 stays `warn`: its evidence
#            predates v0.24.0, where `mx check` is 0 errors and Studio Pro load is untested.
#   pattern  lowercase ERE (POSIX awk; no \b, no lookaround)
#   message  what the hit is
#   fix      the rewrite
#   evidence the bug-log entry holding the captured failure; its fixture is
#            tests/wave2/fixtures/mdl-scan/<id>.{bad,good}.mdl (`-- evidence:` lines)
# A rule with no captured failure in bug-logs/ does not get a row (issue #349).
STOP-1

column6: set it in Studio Pro by hand, or bind dynamictext (Attribute: "State")
